properties.name: (P)-1,1'-binaphthyl, twisted ground-state atropisomer (pre-reaction complex); B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP
properties.axial_stereochemistry: P (defined by tau(C2-C1-C1'-C2') = +69.4 deg); SMILES carries the @ axial marker, the P/M label follows the sign convention stated here

properties.name: transoid (anti) coplanar C1-C1' rotation transition state
cisoid-channel saddle: folded/stacked arrangement that avoids full coplanarity, with the two peri H8/H8' in contact

edges.channel: transoid (anti) coplanar C1-C1' rotation - operative racemization channel
cisoid channel (folds to a stacked saddle instead of reaching coplanarity) - competing, disfavored

notes.level_of_theory: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Gaussian 16 rev C.01, gas phase, electronic energies only (no ZPE, no thermal corrections)
notes.conditions: thermal racemization, ~50 degC, DMF; substrate is a neutral closed-shell hydrocarbon with no acid/base/counterion partner, so the elementary step is unimolecular and the electronic barrier is the reported quantity. CPCM(DMF) single points: RC -770.130180497, TS-A -770.093359020 -> solvated barrier 23.11 kcal/mol (solvent lowers it by 0.37 kcal/mol).
notes.bond_changes_rationale: The step is a pure conformational/axial-inversion step: the C1-C1' bond stays a single bond (1.491 A in RC, 1.497 A in TS-A), no bond order changes, so both break and form lists are empty (atom-map indices refer to the mapped reactant SMILES: axis bond C10-C11, torsion C9-C10-C11-C12).
notes.direction_evidence: Gaussian IRC from TS-A could not leave the very flat torsional saddle (Bulirsch-Stoer corrector 'Delta-x Convergence NOT Met' at point 1). Direction is instead documented by a relaxed B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP torsion scan from the TS geometry (bn_scan_down.log): D=180 +23.48, D=150 +7.13, D=120 +0.93, D=90 +0.36, D=60 +0.18 kcal/mol relative to RC, i.e. monotonic descent from the coplanar saddle into the minimum basin; the mirror-image branch is symmetry-equivalent (enantiomeric) and gives the same energies.
notes.literature_comparison: exp dG(298) = 24.1 kcal/mol; B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP//B3LYP/6-31G(d) + SMD 24.6 kcal/mol (Tan & Paton, Chem. Sci. 2018). Our electronic def2-SVP value 23.5 kcal/mol is consistent within the basis/ZPE bracket.
